violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: THROUGH DISCUSSION WITH THE PIC, THE PORK CHOPS ARE BEING PARTIALLY COOKED TO 120 F THEN HOT HELD FOR UP TO 4 HOURS. WITHIN THE 4 HOURS, IT IS FULLY COOKED ONCE ORDERED BY A CUSTOMER. THIS PROCESS IS NOT APPROVED BY THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. CDI: DISCONTINUE PARTIAL COOKING OF PORK CHOPS. SUBMIT WRITTEN PROCEDURES OF PROCESS TO EHS FOR APPROVAL.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) PORK CHOPS (120 F) IN THE 1-DOOR FLAT TOP HH UNIT (2) AT THE COOK LINE FOR 2 HOURS. OBSERVED PORK CHOPS WITH START AND END TIMES FOR A TOTAL OF 4 HOURS. 2) MASH POTATOES (119 F) AND MILK (108 F) IN THE 1-DOOR UPRIGHT HH UNIT (1) AT THE COOKLINE FOR 3 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: 1) PIC WILL DISCARD PORK CHOPS IF NOT USED IN 2 HOURS. 2) THE MASH POTATOES WERE REHEATED ON THE STOVE AND THE MILK WAS DISCARDED BY THE PIC.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Reminder
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without a reminder statement: OBSERVED THE CONSUMER ADVISORY ON THE MAIN MENU WITH ONLY THE DISCLOSURE STATEMENT.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a reminder statement that includes asterisking (*) the animal-derived foods requiring disclosure to a footnote that states one of the following: 1) 'Regarding the safety of these items, written information is available upon request', or 2) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness', or 3) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions'. CDI: MENUS WERE EDITED AND PRINTED WITH THE FULL CONSUMER ADVISORY INCLUDING THE REMINDER AND DISCLOSURE STATEMENTS ON BOTH THE MAIN AND GLUTEN FREE MENUS DURING THE INSPECTION. SWEETWATER TAVERN (Inspection Date: 10/15/2026) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 1-DOOR HH UPRIGHT UNIT (1) AND 1-DOOR FLAT TOP HH UNIT (2) AT THE COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. OBTAIN HOT HOLDING THERMOMETERS TO GO IN THE UNITS BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED FRUIT FLIES ON BAGGED ONIONS AND POTATOES IN THE DRY STORAGE ROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC REMOVED PRODUCE. ENSURE PEST SERVICE IS CONDUCTED BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION IN 10 DAYS.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. The permit was posted in the wait station area, which is not in public view.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. Please post the permit in a location where the public can see it without entering the food prep area. Correct as soon as possible or within 90 days.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: a tray of raw beef patties was stored over raw pork chops in the butcher walk-in.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). The PIC corrected this on site by moving the trays. CDI.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed wait staff dumping coffee in the handsink next to the warewashing area. The handsink is only to be used for handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. The EHS discussed this with the manager and the manager discussed it with the employee.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. The handwashing signage in the restrooms was incomplete. They simply read. “Please Washed your Hands”.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. The EHS recommended installing signs that notify employees they must wash their hands. Correct before the next routine inspection.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: a case of raw shell eggs was stored on the top shelf in the walk-in over ready-to eat foods.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The manager corrected this by moving the eggs to lower shelves. SWEETWATER TAVERN (Inspection Date: 09/16/2025) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: The final sanitizing rinse temperature of the conveyor-type warewashing machine was below 160F (145F) upon arrival.
violations.corrective_action: This was corrected during the inspection. The final rinse temperature was measured at 160 F after running the unit a few more times.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: the hot holding cabinet closest to the office did not have a thermometer in or on it.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. Provide a thermometer for this unit to ensure it is working correctly.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Packaged Food Display, No Direct Contact Water/Ice
violations.observation: The following packaged food was found stored in direct contact with ice: opening containers of milk were being stored in the ice bath for cooling foods.
violations.corrective_action: Packaged food may not be stored in direct contact with ice or water if the food is subject to the entry of water because of the nature of its packaging, wrapping, or container or its positioning in the ice or water. Ice baths are not appropriate locations to keep milk and other foods cold. The EHS discussed this with the manager and he corrected it during the inspection.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Clean Utensils Storage and Handling
violations.observation: Observed clean knives and cutting utensils stored improperly between equipment next to the deep fat fryer.
violations.corrective_action: Utensils must be stored in clean, dry locations, and not between equipment. The manager corrected this during the inspection.

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Several clean pans were found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. The EHS discussed this with the manager. Correct before the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: There were several places where the kitchen floor was deteriorated and there were six inch wide holes in it. This creates a cleaning challenge and a trip hazard for food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Please repair or replace the deteriorated kitchen floor before the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking cup used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils: smoothie cup observed in production walk-in at prep table.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Pork Chop observed in hot holding unit at 94F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC stated the pork chop had been there for 1 hour and the intention was to hold the pork on time after cooking. SWEETWATER TAVERN (Inspection Date: 03/21/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: raw chicken observed at 46-48F in tabletop cooler near grill.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC stated the chicken had been there for an hour and that the unit was never turned on. Staff added ice below the chicken containers and powered on the unit to cool the chicken down quickly.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: hamburger buns, Parmesan on pasta
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. Discarded food and trained staff.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: plates, utensils because the heat sanitizing dish machine was registering at 145F, 153F.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. Set up 3 compartment sink with quaternary ammonia.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: pork chop at 91F, whole chicken at 49F, prime rib at 124F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Reheated food.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: garlic & oil in squeeze bottle at grill, cooked broccolini at grill, cabbage slaw on counter, cilantro vinaigrette in squeeze bottle, corn salad, ozzy roll butter in pastry bags and in metal ramekins.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. Provided time mark and trained staff.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: flour, sugar, panko, food squeeze bottles.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. Labeled food.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly: heat sanitizing dish machine in the kitchen was at 153F then 145F when tested with an irreversible thermometer.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Contacted technician for service. Please repair prior to reinspection on 1/13/2025.
